Discover the Enchanting Charm of Jiu Fen in Taipei

Nestled in the enchanting hills of Taipei, Jiu Fen is a must-visit destination for travelers seeking a unique and picturesque experience. This historic mining town, once a bustling center of gold mining, has transformed into a charming maze of narrow alleyways, traditional tea houses, and stunning views of the surrounding mountains and ocean. As you wander through the labyrinthine streets of Jiu Fen, you'll be captivated by its old-world charm and timeless beauty. The traditional architecture, adorned with red lanterns and intricate woodwork, adds to the nostalgic atmosphere. Explore the various shops and stalls selling local handicrafts, souvenirs, and mouthwatering street food. Indulge in a cup of fragrant tea at one of the many tea houses, where you can relax and take in the breathtaking panoramic views of the rolling hills and the deep blue sea. Jiu Fen is also famous for its connection to the renowned animated film, 'Spirited Away.' The town's winding alleys and lantern-lit streets bear a striking resemblance to the film's magical setting. Immerse yourself in the whimsical ambiance and let your imagination soar as you explore this charming destination. Whether you're a history buff, an art enthusiast, or simply seeking a tranquil escape from the bustling city, Jiu Fen offers a truly unforgettable experience.

Getting to Sunny Room from Taipei's Nearest Airports

Sunny Room, nestled in the charming village of Jiu Fen in Taipei, Taiwan, offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city life. To reach this hidden gem, you have several options from the nearest airports: Taipei Songshan Airport and Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. If you arrive at Taipei Songshan Airport, the most convenient way to reach Sunny Room is by taking a taxi or private car. The journey takes approximately 45 minutes, offering scenic views of the city and its outskirts. Alternatively, you can take the MRT from Songshan Airport Station to Zhongxiao Fuxing Station, and then transfer to the Tamsui-Xinyi Line towards Tamsui. Get off at Jiantan Station and take bus route 1062 to Jiu Fen Old Street, which is a short walk from Sunny Room. For those arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, the most efficient option is to take a taxi or private car directly to Jiu Fen. The journey takes around 1 hour and 30 minutes, depending on traffic conditions. Alternatively, you can take the Airport MRT from Taoyuan Airport Terminal 1 or Terminal 2 to Taipei Main Station. From there, transfer to the Tamsui-Xinyi Line towards Tamsui and alight at Jiantan Station. From Jiantan Station, take bus route 1062 to Jiu Fen Old Street, where you can easily find Sunny Room. Whether you choose to embark on a scenic drive or opt for public transportation, reaching Sunny Room from Taipei's nearest airports is an adventure in itself. The journey allows you to soak in the stunning landscapes of Taipei as you make your way to this idyllic retreat in Jiu Fen.

Discover the Natural and Cultural Gems near Sunny Room

Nestled in the heart of Taipei, Sunny Room offers guests the perfect base to explore the surrounding natural and cultural wonders. Just a short distance away, you'll find a plethora of landmarks and attractions that will leave you awe-inspired. Golden Waterfall, with its shimmering golden hues, is a sight to behold, and Jinguashih, a historic mining town, offers a glimpse into Taiwan's rich mining heritage. The Shuinandong Smelter and Gold Museum provide fascinating insights into the gold mining industry, while Qitang Old Street and Jiufen Goldore Museum showcase the area's traditional architecture and gold mining artifacts. For those seeking outdoor adventures, the Shanjian Road Trail and Longdongwan Park are perfect for hiking and enjoying breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes. Teapot Mountain, known for its unique rock formations, is a must-visit for nature enthusiasts. And if you're looking to relax by the sea, Quanjitang offers a serene beach experience. With such a diverse range of attractions nearby, Sunny Room ensures that every guest can immerse themselves in the beauty and history of Taipei's surroundings.

  1. 9.2Exceptional

    mitsuhiro from Japan
    Couple
    Standard Double Suite
    Stayed 1 night in September 2026

    “Breathtaking view! A place you must stay at at least once.”

    First time in Taiwan (3 nights, 4 days). I didn't hesitate about staying in Jiu Fen — no need to, since it's cheaper than hotels in central Taipei. I arrived in Taiwan early afternoon, went to Taipei Main Station, did a little sightseeing, then headed to Jiu Fen. Check-in was in a lobby-like area. With a translation app I had no trouble getting to the room... it was a very spacious, open-plan room with a high atrium feel. It felt new. The toilet paper is flushable. The shower room (washroom) was separated by a door — I’d read reviews saying it was open and uncomfortable, but it was fine for me. Open the curtains and you can take in that famous stunning view you see in Jiu Fen guides. I took the first bus back to Taipei in the morning to start a food tour, so I didn’t have breakfast at the hotel.

  2. 10.0Exceptional

    KANAMI from Japan
    Group
    Sea View Double Room with Balcony
    Stayed 1 night in March 2026

    “The scenery is amazing! It was a spacious and wonderful room.”

    I had been curious about this place for a while! The location is toward the lower part of Jiu Fen Old Street — you enter just below the Amecha shop. There are a lot of slopes and stairs, so it's difficult with a wheeled suitcase, but on the way back the staff carried it to the bus stop for me. The view from the second-floor room was wonderful — I could even see Jiu Fen’s sunset! The room was spacious and clean, with a bathtub and large windows that felt very open. The terrace was also pleasant. You can add breakfast for 150 TWD, and it was very tasty! There’s a dog on the property and it was adorable. The staff were kind, and I had a great stay.
